verses.arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُو۟لِىٓ أَجْنِحَةٍ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَـٰثَ وَرُبَـٰعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.latinEn: Alhamdu lillahi fatiri assamawatiwal-ardi jaAAili almala-ikatirusulan olee ajnihatin mathna wathulathawarubaAAa yazeedu fee alkhalqi ma yashaoinna Allaha AAala kulli shay-in qadeer
verses.latinId: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi fāṭiris-samāwāti wal-arḍi jā‘ilil-malāikati rusulā(n), ulī ajniḥatim maṡnā wa ṡulāṡa wa rubā‘(a), yazīdu fil-khalqi mā yasyā'(u), innallāha ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).

verses.arabic: مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.latinEn: Ma yaftahi Allahu linnasimin rahmatin fala mumsika laha wamayumsik fala mursila lahu min baAAdihi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeem
verses.latinId: Mā yaftaḥillāhu lin-nāsi mir raḥmatin falā mumsika lahā, wa mā yumsik falā mursila lahū mim ba‘dih(ī), wa huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ هَلْ مِنْ خَـٰلِقٍ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.latinEn: Ya ayyuha annasuothkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum hal min khaliqinghayru Allahi yarzuqukum mina assama-i wal-ardila ilaha illa huwa faanna tu/fakoon
verses.latinId: Yā ayyuhan-nāsużkurū ni‘matallāhi ‘alaikum, hal min khāliqin gairullāhi yarzuqukum minas-samā'i wal-arḍ(i), lā ilāha illā huw(a), fa'annā tu'fakūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.latinEn: Wa-in yukaththibooka faqad kuththibatrusulun min qablika wa-ila Allahi turjaAAu al-omoor
verses.latinId: Wa iy yukażżibūka faqad kużżibat rusulum min qablik(a), wa ilallāhi turja‘ul-umūr(u).

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
verses.latinEn: Ya ayyuha annasuinna waAAda Allahi haqqun falataghurrannakumu alhayatu addunya walayaghurrannakum billahi algharoor
verses.latinId: Yā ayyuhan-nāsu inna wa‘dallāhi ḥaqqun falā tagurrannakumul-ḥayātud-dun-yā, wa lā yagurrannakum billāhil-garūr(u).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ فَٱتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا ۚ إِنَّمَا يَدْعُوا۟ حِزْبَهُۥ لِيَكُونُوا۟ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.latinEn: Inna ashshaytana lakumAAaduwwun fattakhithoohu AAaduwwan innamayadAAoo hizbahu liyakoonoo min as-habi assaAAeer
verses.latinId: Innasy-syaiṭāna lakum ‘aduwwun fattakhiżūhu ‘aduwwā(n), innamā yad‘ū  ḥizbahū liyakūnū min aṣḥābis-sa‘īr(i).

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.latinEn: Allatheena kafaroo lahum AAathabunshadeedun wallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo assalihatilahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeer
verses.latinId: Allażīna kafarū lahum ‘ażābun syadīd(un), wal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti lahum magfiratuw wa ajrun kabīr(un).

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًا ۖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَٰتٍ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
verses.latinEn: Afaman zuyyina lahu soo-o AAamalihi faraahuhasanan fa-inna Allaha yudillu man yashaowayahdee man yashao fala tathhab nafsukaAAalayhim hasaratin inna Allaha AAaleemunbima yasnaAAoon
verses.latinId: Afaman zuyyina lahū sū'u ‘amalihī fara'āhu ḥasanā(n), fa'innallāha yuḍillu may yasyā'u wa yahdī may yasyā'(u), falā tażhab nafsuka ‘alaihim ḥasarāt(in), innallāha ‘alīmum bimā yaṣna‘ūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَسُقْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ مَّيِّتٍ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلنُّشُورُ
verses.latinEn: Wallahu allathee arsalaarriyaha fatutheeru sahaban fasuqnahuila baladin mayyitin faahyayna bihi al-ardabaAAda mawtiha kathalika annushoor
verses.latinId: Wallāhul-lażī arsalar-riyāḥa fatuṡīru saḥāban fasuqnāhu ilā baladim mayyitin fa'aḥyainā bihil-arḍa ba‘da mautihā, każālikan-nusyūr(u).

verses.arabic: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ ٱلْكَلِمُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ وَٱلْعَمَلُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُ يَرْفَعُهُۥ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۖ وَمَكْرُ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ
verses.latinEn: Man kana yureedu alAAizzata falillahialAAizzatu jameeAAan ilayhi yasAAadu alkalimu attayyibuwalAAamalu assalihu yarfaAAuhu wallatheenayamkuroona assayyi-ati lahum AAathabunshadeedun wamakru ola-ika huwa yaboor
verses.latinId: Man kāna yurīdul-‘izzata falillāhil-‘izzatu jamī‘ā(n), ilaihi yaṣ‘adul-kalimuṭ-ṭayyibu wal-‘amaluṣ-ṣāliḥu yarfa‘uh(ū), wal-lażīna yamkurūnas-sayyi'āti lahum ‘ażābun syadīd(un), wa makru ulā'ika huwa yabūr(u).

verses.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ۚ وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِۦٓ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
verses.latinEn: Wallahu khalaqakum min turabinthumma min nutfatin thumma jaAAalakum azwajan wamatahmilu min ontha wala tadaAAu illabiAAilmihi wama yuAAammaru min muAAammarin walayunqasu min AAumurihi illa fee kitabin inna thalikaAAala Allahi yaseer
verses.latinId: Wallāhu khalaqakum min turābin ṡumma min nuṭfatin ṡumma ja‘alakum azwājā(n), wa mā taḥmilu min unṡā wa lā taḍa‘u illā bi‘ilmih(ī), wa mā yu‘ammaru mim mu‘ammariw wa lā yunqaṣu min ‘umurihī illā fī kitāb(in), inna żālika ‘alallāhi yasīr(un).

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْبَحْرَانِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ سَآئِغٌ شَرَابُهُۥ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ ۖ وَمِن كُلٍّ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا ۖ وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.latinEn: Wama yastawee albahranihatha AAathbun furatun sa-ighun sharabuhuwahatha milhun ojajun wamin kullinta/kuloona lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoona hilyatantalbasoonaha watara alfulka feehi mawakhiralitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroon
verses.latinId: Wa mā yastawil-baḥrān(i), hāżā ‘ażbun furātun sā'igun syarābuhū wa hāżā milḥun ujāj(un), wa min kullin ta'kulūna laḥman ṭariyyaw wa tastakhrijūna ḥilyatan talbasūnahā, wa taral-fulka fīhi mawākhira litabtagū min faḍlihī wa la‘allakum tasykurūn(a).

verses.arabic: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ
verses.latinEn: Yooliju allayla fee annahariwayooliju annahara fee allayli wasakhkhara ashshamsawalqamara kullun yajree li-ajalin musamman thalikumuAllahu rabbukum lahu almulku wallatheenatadAAoona min doonihi ma yamlikoona min qitmeer
verses.latinId: Yūlijul-laila fin-nahāri wa yūlijun-nahāra fil-lail(i), wa sakhkharasy-syamsa wal-qamara kulluy yajrī li'ajalim musammā(n), żālikumullāhu rabbukum lahul-mulk(u), wal-lażīna tad‘ūna min dūnihī mā yamlikūna min qiṭmīr(in).

verses.arabic: إِن تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوا۟ دُعَآءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوا۟ مَا ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لَكُمْ ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍ
verses.latinEn: In tadAAoohum la yasmaAAoo duAAaakumwalaw samiAAoo ma istajaboo lakum wayawma alqiyamatiyakfuroona bishirkikum wala yunabbi-oka mithlu khabeer
verses.latinId: In tad‘ūhum lā yasma‘ū du‘ā'akum, wa lau sami‘ū mastajābū lakum, wa yaumal-qiyāmati yakfurūna bisyirkikum, wa lā yunabbi'uka miṡlu khabīr(in).

verses.arabic: ۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verses.latinEn: Ya ayyuha annasuantumu alfuqarao ila Allahi wallahuhuwa alghaniyyu alhameed
verses.latinId: Yā ayyuhan-nāsu antumul-fuqarā'u ilallāh(i), wallāhu huwal-ganiyyul-ḥamīd(u).

verses.arabic: إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
verses.latinEn: In yasha/ yuthhibkum waya/tibikhalqin jadeed
verses.latinId: Iy yasya' yużhibkum wa ya'ti bikhalqin jadīd(in).

verses.arabic: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍ
verses.latinEn: Wama thalika AAala AllahibiAAazeez
verses.latinId: Wa mā żālika ‘alallāhi bi‘azīz(in).

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰٓ ۗ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۚ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.latinEn: Wala taziru waziratun wizraokhra wa-in tadAAu muthqalatun ila himlihala yuhmal minhu shay-on walaw kana thaqurba innama tunthiru allatheenayakhshawna rabbahum bilghaybi waaqamoo assalatawaman tazakka fa-innama yatazakka linafsihiwa-ila Allahi almaseer
verses.latinId: Wa lā taziru wāziratuw wizra ukhrā, wa in tad‘u muṡqalatun ilā ḥimlihā lā yuḥmal minhu syai'uw wa lau kāna żā qurbā, innamā tunżirul-lażīna yakhsyauna rabbahum bil-gaibi wa aqāmuṣ-ṣalāh(ta), wa man tazakkā fa innamā yatazakkā linafsih(ī), wa ilallāhil-maṣīr(u).

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ
verses.latinEn: Wama yastawee al-aAAma walbaseer
verses.latinId: Wa mā yastawil-a‘mā wal-baṣīr(u).

verses.arabic: وَلَا ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتُ وَلَا ٱلنُّورُ
verses.latinEn: Wala aththulumatuwala annoor
verses.latinId: Wa laẓ-ẓulumātu wa lan-nūr(u).

verses.arabic: وَلَا ٱلظِّلُّ وَلَا ٱلْحَرُورُ
verses.latinEn: Wala aththilluwala alharoor
verses.latinId: Wa laẓ-ẓillu wa lal-ḥarūr(u).

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَحْيَآءُ وَلَا ٱلْأَمْوَٰتُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَّن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
verses.latinEn: Wama yastawee al-ahyaowala al-amwatu inna Allaha yusmiAAu man yashaowama anta bimusmiAAin man fee alquboor
verses.latinId: Wa mā yastawil-aḥyā'u wa lal-amwāt(u), innallāha yusmi‘u may yasyā'(u), wa mā anta bimusmi‘im man fil-qubūr(i).

verses.arabic: إِنْ أَنتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ
verses.latinEn: In anta illa natheer
verses.latinId: In anta illā nażīr(un).

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۚ وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ
verses.latinEn: Inna arsalnaka bilhaqqibasheeran wanatheeran wa-in min ommatin illa khalafeeha natheer
verses.latinId: Innā arsalnāka bil-ḥaqqi basyīraw wa nażīrā(n), wa im min ummatin illā khalā fīhā nażīr(un).

verses.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَبِٱلزُّبُرِ وَبِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُنِيرِ
verses.latinEn: Wa-in yukaththibooka faqad kaththabaallatheena min qablihim jaat-hum rusuluhum bilbayyinatiwabizzuburi wabilkitabi almuneer
verses.latinId: Wa iy yukażżibūka faqad każżabal-lażīna min qablihim, jā'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyināti wa biz-zuburi wa bil-kitābil-munīr(i).

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.latinEn: Thumma akhathtu allatheenakafaroo fakayfa kana nakeer
verses.latinId: Ṡumma akhażtul-lażīna kafarū fakaifa kāna nakīr(i).

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ ثَمَرَٰتٍ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌۢ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ
verses.latinEn: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina assama-imaan faakhrajna bihi thamaratin mukhtalifanalwanuha wamina aljibali judadun beedunwahumrun mukhtalifun alwanuha wagharabeebusood
verses.latinId: Alam tara annallāha anzala minas-samā'i mā'ā(n), fa'akhrajnā bihī ṡamarātim mukhtalifan alwānuhā, wa minal-jibāli judadum bīḍuw wa khumrum mukhtalifun alwānuhā wa garābību sūd(un).

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱلدَّوَآبِّ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ
verses.latinEn: Wamina annasi waddawabbiwal-anAAami mukhtalifun alwanuhu kathalikainnama yakhsha Allaha min AAibadihialAAulamao inna Allaha AAazeezun ghafoor
verses.latinId: Wa minan-nāsi wad-dawābbi wal-an‘āmi mukhtalifun alwānuhū każālik(a), innamā yakhsyallāha min ‘ibādihil-ulamā'(u), innallāha ‘azīzun gafūr(un).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَـٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَـٰرَةً لَّن تَبُورَ
verses.latinEn: Inna allatheena yatloona kitabaAllahi waaqamoo assalatawaanfaqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran waAAalaniyatanyarjoona tijaratan lan taboor
verses.latinId: Innal-lażīna yatlūna kitāballāhi wa aqāmuṣ-ṣalāta wa anfaqū mimmā razaqnāhum sirraw wa ‘alāniyatay yarjūna tijāratal lan tabūr(a).

verses.arabic: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
verses.latinEn: Liyuwaffiyahum ojoorahum wayazeedahum min fadlihiinnahu ghafoorun shakoor
verses.latinId: Liyuwaffiyahum ujūrahum wa yazīdahum min faḍlih(ī), innahū gafūrun syakūr(un).

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ لَخَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verses.latinEn: Wallathee awhaynailayka mina alkitabi huwa alhaqqu musaddiqanlima bayna yadayhi inna Allaha biAAibadihilakhabeerun baseer
verses.latinId: Wal-lażī auḥainā ilaika minal-kitābi huwal-ḥaqqu muṣaddiqal limā baina yadaih(i), innallāha bi‘ibādihī lakhabīrum baṣīr(un).

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌۢ بِٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.latinEn: Thumma awrathna alkitaba allatheenaistafayna min AAibadina faminhum thalimunlinafsihi waminhum muqtasidun waminhum sabiqun bilkhayratibi-ithni Allahi thalika huwa alfadlualkabeer
verses.latinId: Ṡumma auraṡnal-kitābal-lażīnaṣṭafainā min ‘ibādinā, fa minhum ẓālimul linafsih(ī), wa minhum muqtaṣid(un), wa minhum sābiqum bil-khairāti bi'iżnillāh(i), żālika huwal-faḍlul-kabīr(u).

verses.arabic: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ
verses.latinEn: Jannatu AAadnin yadkhuloonahayuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabinwalu/lu-an walibasuhum feeha hareer
verses.latinId: Jannātu ‘adniy yadkhulūnahā yuḥallauna fīhā min asāwira min żahabiw wa lu'lu'ā(n), wa libāsuhum fīhā ḥarīr(un).

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ ۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
verses.latinEn: Waqaloo alhamdu lillahiallathee athhaba AAanna alhazana innarabbana laghafoorun shakoor
verses.latinId: Wa qālul-ḥamdu lillāhil-lażī ażhaba ‘annal-ḥazan(a), inna rabbanā lagafūrun syakūr(un).

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ
verses.latinEn: Allathee ahallana daraalmuqamati min fadlihi la yamassunafeeha nasabun wala yamassuna feehalughoob
verses.latinId: Allażī aḥallanā dāral-muqāmati min faḍlih(ī), lā yamassunā fīhā naṣabuw wa lā yamassunā fīhā lugūb(un).

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا۟ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى كُلَّ كَفُورٍ
verses.latinEn: Wallatheena kafaroo lahum narujahannama la yuqda AAalayhim fayamootoo walayukhaffafu AAanhum min AAathabiha kathalikanajzee kulla kafoor
verses.latinId: Wal-lażīna kafarū lahum nāru jahannam(a), lā yuqḍā ‘alaihim fayamūtū wa lā yukhaffafu ‘anhum min ‘ażābihā, każālika najzī kulla kafūr(in).

verses.arabic: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَآءَكُمُ ٱلنَّذِيرُ ۖ فَذُوقُوا۟ فَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
verses.latinEn: Wahum yastarikhoona feeharabbana akhrijna naAAmal salihanghayra allathee kunna naAAmalu awa lam nuAAammirkumma yatathakkaru feehi man tathakkara wajaakumuannatheeru fathooqoo fama liththalimeenamin naseer
verses.latinId: Wa hum yaṣṭarikhūna fīhā, rabbanā akhirjnā na‘mal ṣāliḥan gairal-lażī kunnā na‘mal(u), awalam nu‘ammirkum mā yatażakkaru fīhi man tażakkara wa jā'akumun nażīr(u), fa żūqū famā liẓ-ẓālimīna min naṣīr(in).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَـٰلِمُ غَيْبِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.latinEn: Inna Allaha AAalimu ghaybi assamawatiwal-ardi innahu AAaleemun bithati assudoor
verses.latinId: Innallāha ‘ālimu gaibis-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), innahū ‘alīmum biżātiṣ-ṣudūr(i).

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَـٰٓئِفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
verses.latinEn: Huwa allathee jaAAalakum khala-ifafee al-ardi faman kafara faAAalayhi kufruhu walayazeedu alkafireena kufruhum AAinda rabbihim illamaqtan wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum illakhasara
verses.latinId: Huwal-lażī ja‘alakum khalā'ifa fil-arḍ(i), faman kafara fa‘alaihi kufruh(ū), wa lā yazīdul-kāfirīna kufruhum ‘inda rabbihim illā maqtā(n), wa lā yazīdul-kāfirīna kufruhum illā khasārā(n).

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتَـٰبًا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍ مِّنْهُ ۚ بَلْ إِن يَعِدُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا
verses.latinEn: Qul araaytum shurakaakumu allatheenatadAAoona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoomina al-ardi am lahum shirkun fee assamawatiam ataynahum kitaban fahum AAalabayyinatin minhu bal in yaAAidu aththalimoonabaAAduhum baAAdan illa ghuroora
verses.latinId: Qul ara'aitum syurakā'akumul-lażīna tad‘ūna min dūnillāh(i), arūnī māżā khalaqū minal-arḍi am lahum syirkun fis-samāwāt(i), am ātaināhum kitāban fahum ‘alā bayyinatim minh(u), bal iy ya‘iduẓ-ẓālimūna ba‘ḍuhum ba‘ḍan illā gurūrā(n).

verses.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا ۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا
verses.latinEn: Inna Allaha yumsiku assamawatiwal-arda an tazoola wala-in zalatain amsakahuma min ahadin min baAAdihi innahu kanahaleeman ghafoora
verses.latinId: Innallāha yumsikus-samāwāti wal-arḍa an tazūlā, wa la'in zālatā in amsakahumā min aḥadim mim ba‘dih(ī), innahū kāna ḥalīman gafūrā(n).

verses.arabic: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى ٱلْأُمَمِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
verses.latinEn: Waaqsamoo billahi jahda aymanihimla-in jaahum natheerun layakoonunna ahda minihda al-omami falamma jaahum natheerunma zadahum illa nufoora
verses.latinId: Wa aqsamū billāhi jahda aimānihim la'in jā'ahum nażīrul layakūnunna ahdā min iḥdal-umam(i), falammā jā'ahum nażīrum mā zādahum illā nufūrā(n).

verses.arabic: ٱسْتِكْبَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ ٱلسَّيِّئِ ۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلْمَكْرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِۦ ۚ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا
verses.latinEn: Istikbaran fee al-ardi wamakraassayyi-i wala yaheequ almakru assayyi-oilla bi-ahlihi fahal yanthuroona illasunnata al-awwaleena falan tajida lisunnati Allahitabdeelan walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tahweela
verses.latinId: Istikbāran fil-arḍi wa makras-sayyi'(i), wa lā yaḥīqul-makrus-sayyi'u illā bi'ahlih(ī), fahal yanẓurūna illā sunnatal-awwalīn(a), falan tajida lisunnatillāhi tabdīlā(n), wa lan tajida lisunnatillāhi taḥwīlā(n).

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمًا قَدِيرًا
verses.latinEn: Awa lam yaseeroo fee al-ardi fayanthurookayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihimwakanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan wama kanaAllahu liyuAAjizahu min shay-in fee assamawatiwala fee al-ardi innahu kana AAaleemanqadeera
verses.latinId: Awalam yasīrū fil-arḍi fa yanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-lażīna min qablihim wa kānū asyadda minhum quwwah(tan), wa mā kānallāhu liyu‘jizahū min syai'in fis-samāwāti wa lā fil-arḍ(i), innahū kāna ‘alīman qadīrā(n).

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرًۢا
verses.latinEn: Walaw yu-akhithu Allahuannasa bima kasaboo ma taraka AAalathahriha min dabbatin walakinyu-akhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman fa-itha jaaajaluhum fa-inna Allaha kana biAAibadihi baseera
verses.latinId: Wa lau yu'ākhiżullāhun-nāsa bimā kasabū mā taraka ‘alā ẓahrihā min dābbatiw wa lākiy yu'akhkhiruhum ilā ajalim musammā(n), fa iżā jā'a ajaluhum fa innallāha kāna bi‘ibādihī baṣīrā(n).
